categories.name: Surveys
categories.description: A broader map of the field; its full scope is wider than this catalog.

categories.name: Foundations and Early UI Reconstruction
categories.description: Early image-to-UI approaches and their restricted representations.

categories.name: Datasets and Multimodal Code Models
categories.description: Training resources and models that connect screenshots, rendered artifacts and source code.

categories.name: Layout-Aware and Tool-Grounded Generation
categories.description: Decomposition, explicit layout reasoning and visual evidence extraction before code synthesis.

categories.name: Render-Feedback Optimization
categories.description: Inference-time critique, learned refinement and reinforcement learning from rendered results.

categories.name: Visual Editing and Interactive Reconstruction
categories.description: Human visual edits and reconstruction of interfaces with multiple observable states.

categories.name: Evaluation Benchmarks
categories.description: Different inputs, outputs and success criteria; these benchmarks are not interchangeable.

categories.name: Adjacent Image-to-Graphics Research
categories.description: A bounded extension for transferable rendering-based supervision; no claim of comprehensive graphics coverage.

entries.label: Beyond NL2Code
entries.title: Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence
entries.english: Organizes multimodal code intelligence by the role of code and by application domain, including UI generation, scientific visualization and structured graphics. Its discussion of semantic and interaction evidence provides a broader context than this UI-centered catalog.
entries.chinese: 按代码的作用和应用领域梳理多模态代码智能，涵盖 UI 生成、科学可视化和结构化图形。其对语义与交互证据的讨论，为本目录以 UI 为中心的范围提供更广泛的背景。
entries.evidence_note: A broader survey, included for orientation; robotics and other frontier domains in the survey are outside this catalog.

entries.label: pix2code
entries.title: pix2code: Generating Code from a Graphical User Interface Screenshot
entries.english: Combines a CNN image encoder with recurrent language modeling to predict a lightweight GUI-specific language from a screenshot. The representation targets layout and component relationships and ignores actual label text, so it should not be read as unrestricted webpage reconstruction.
entries.chinese: 结合 CNN 图像编码器与循环语言模型，从截图预测轻量的 GUI 专用语言。该表示关注布局与组件关系，并忽略标签的实际文本，因此不应将其视为不受限制的网页重建。
entries.evidence_note: Read the vision model, DSL definition and decoder. The scope qualification follows the explicit treatment of label text.

entries.label: ReDraw
entries.title: Machine Learning-Based Prototyping of Graphical User Interfaces for Mobile Apps
entries.english: Detects GUI components from mockup metadata or images, classifies their types with a CNN trained on mined app data, and assembles a hierarchy using a nearest-neighbor approach. The implemented system targets Android GUI prototypes, rather than complete application behavior.
entries.chinese: 从设计稿元数据或图像中检测 GUI 组件，用基于挖掘所得应用数据训练的 CNN 识别组件类型，再通过近邻方法组装层级结构。所实现系统面向 Android GUI 原型，而非完整应用行为。
entries.evidence_note: Read the approach overview and detection branch. Android prototyping is the declared implementation scope; no end-to-end application functionality is certified.

entries.label: WebSight
entries.title: Unlocking the conversion of Web Screenshots into HTML Code with the WebSight Dataset
entries.english: Builds screenshot–HTML training pairs by generating website concepts, synthesizing HTML with Tailwind CSS, filtering outputs and rendering pages. It demonstrates VLM fine-tuning on synthetic data; this is a training resource, not a real-world reconstruction benchmark.
entries.chinese: 通过生成网站构想、合成带 Tailwind CSS 的 HTML、过滤输出并渲染页面，构建截图与 HTML 训练对。论文展示了在合成数据上微调 VLM；这是训练资源，而非真实网页重建基准。
entries.evidence_note: Inspected the construction pipeline. Avoid conflating the paper corpus with earlier releases of the dataset card.

entries.label: WebCode2M / WebCoder
entries.title: WebCode2M: A Real-World Dataset for Code Generation from Webpage Designs
entries.english: Curates real-web screenshot, code and layout data through code purification, rendering and quality filtering. Introduces the WebCoder baseline and TreeBLEU for structural hierarchy recall; cleaned static pages do not preserve every behavior of the original websites.
entries.chinese: 通过代码清理、渲染和质量过滤，整理真实网页的截图、代码及布局数据。提出 WebCoder 基线和用于结构层级召回的 TreeBLEU；清理后的静态页面并不保留原网站的全部行为。
entries.evidence_note: Read purification and rendering details, including removal of script tags. Baseline and TreeBLEU identity were also checked in the abstract.

entries.label: Web2Code
entries.title: Web2Code: A Large-scale Webpage-to-Code Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Multimodal LLMs
entries.english: Uses language models to expand webpage–code data and adds question–answer pairs about webpage content. Couples instruction-tuning data with evaluations of webpage understanding and screenshot-to-HTML generation, keeping these two capabilities distinct.
entries.chinese: 利用语言模型扩充网页与代码数据，并加入关于网页内容的问答对。将指令微调数据与网页理解、截图到 HTML 生成评测结合，同时区分这两种能力。
entries.evidence_note: Metadata and abstract only; construction details and experimental results were not method-reviewed.

entries.label: Flame
entries.title: Advancing vision-language models in front-end development via data synthesis
entries.english: Synthesizes frontend training data by extracting self-contained components, rendering them and generating descriptions, with evolution, waterfall and additive synthesis strategies. Trains a vision-language model for image-and-instruction-to-React generation and studies interpretation before coding.
entries.chinese: 通过提取自包含组件、渲染组件并生成描述来合成前端训练数据，并采用演化式、瀑布式和增量式合成策略。训练视觉语言模型完成图像与指令到 React 的生成，并研究先理解图像再编码的方式。
entries.evidence_note: Abstract-level account; Flame-React-Eval is an associated evaluation asset, not a second counted paper.

entries.label: JanusCoder / JanusCoderV
entries.title: JanusCoder: Towards a Foundational Visual-Programmatic Interface for Code Intelligence
entries.english: Introduces a multimodal code synthesis toolkit and corpus spanning charts, interactive web UIs and code-driven animation. The model family supports text and visual coding settings; this entry includes the visual branch and does not equate every model variant with a vision-capable model.
entries.chinese: 提出多模态代码合成工具与语料，涵盖图表、交互式网页 UI 和代码驱动的动画。该模型系列支持文本与视觉编程场景；本条目收录其视觉分支，不将每个模型变体都视为具备视觉能力。
entries.evidence_note: Scope restricted to visual-input and visual-output coding. No cross-benchmark superiority claim retained.

entries.label: DCGen
entries.title: Divide-and-Conquer: Generating UI Code from Screenshots
entries.english: Recursively divides a screenshot along visual separation lines, generates code for the resulting segments, and assembles child implementations into the full page. The reviewed revision uses segment-level code generation, which differs from the descriptions-first account in earlier versions.
entries.chinese: 沿视觉分隔线递归划分截图，为得到的子区域生成代码，再将子区域实现组装成完整页面。所核验版本采用子区域级代码生成，与早期版本先生成描述的表述不同。
entries.evidence_note: The v3 full-text heading is Divide-and-Conquer: Generating UI Code from Screenshots; the abstract-page citation_title metadata retained the earlier title. Used the reviewed full-text title.

entries.label: ScreenCoder
entries.title: ScreenCoder: Advancing Visual-to-Code Generation for Front-End Automation via Modular Multimodal Agents
entries.english: Separates screenshot-to-code into visual grounding, layout planning and code generation using specialized agents. Also uses the pipeline to synthesize image–code pairs for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning of an open model.
entries.chinese: 借助专门的智能体，将截图到代码拆分为视觉定位、布局规划和代码生成。还利用该流程合成图像与代码对，以对开放模型进行监督微调和强化学习。
entries.evidence_note: v2 abstract checked; code availability and reported performance were not independently reproduced.

entries.label: LaTCoder
entries.title: LaTCoder: Converting Webpage Design to Code with Layout-as-Thought
entries.english: Divides webpage designs into image blocks and uses Layout-as-Thought prompting to generate their code. It compares absolute-position and model-based assembly through dynamic selection, and introduces CC-HARD to study complex layouts.
entries.chinese: 将网页设计划分为图像块，并通过 Layout-as-Thought 提示生成各块代码。借助动态选择比较绝对定位与模型驱动的组装方式，并引入 CC-HARD 研究复杂布局。
entries.evidence_note: Abstract-level mechanism; CC-HARD is kept with its originating paper to avoid double counting.

entries.label: WidgetGen
entries.title: From Visual Widgets to UI Code: Efficient Tool-Grounded Generation
entries.english: Extracts visible text and color evidence, performs layout and optional chart reasoning, then directly generates JSX for individual widgets. Its focus is selective tool grounding at widget scale, rather than assuming a fixed component schema or full-site reconstruction.
entries.chinese: 提取可见文本与颜色证据，进行布局及可选的图表推理，再直接为单个组件生成 JSX。其重点是在组件尺度上选择性地借助工具获取依据，而非假定固定组件模式或重建完整网站。
entries.evidence_note: Abstract checked. Widget-scale results should not be generalized to full applications.

entries.label: ReLook
entries.title: ReLook: Vision-Grounded RL with a Multimodal LLM Critic for Agentic Web Coding
entries.english: Trains a coding agent with screenshot-based rewards and actionable feedback from a multimodal critic, rejecting non-improving revisions through Forced Optimization. The described inference procedure removes the critic and uses self-editing, so training-time visual feedback is not continuous inference-time critique.
entries.chinese: 使用基于截图的奖励及多模态评审器提供的可执行反馈训练编程智能体，并通过 Forced Optimization 拒绝未带来改进的修订。所述推理流程移除评审器并采用自编辑，因此训练期视觉反馈不等同于推理期持续视觉评审。
entries.evidence_note: The training/inference distinction is explicit in the primary abstract; no stronger guarantee about deployment behavior is inferred.

entries.label: UI2Code^N
entries.title: UI2Code^N: UI-to-Code Generation as Interactive Visual Optimization
entries.english: Frames drafting, polishing and localized editing as code updates conditioned on visual execution feedback. The reviewed revision introduces Relative Visual Policy Optimization, learning from relative preferences between rendered candidates instead of relying on calibrated absolute visual scores.
entries.chinese: 将初稿生成、润色和局部编辑建模为以视觉执行反馈为条件的代码更新。所核验版本提出相对视觉策略优化，从渲染候选之间的相对偏好学习，而非依赖经过校准的绝对视觉分数。
entries.evidence_note: v4 changes the title and foregrounds RVPO. Editing is explicitly localized and well specified; not general autonomous design.

entries.label: VisRefiner
entries.title: VisRefiner: Learning from Visual Differences for Screenshot-to-Code Generation
entries.english: Aligns differences between target and rendered screenshots with corrective code through supervised refinement pairs. A subsequent reinforcement-learning stage uses visual improvement to learn self-refinement, connecting code changes to their rendered consequences during training.
entries.chinese: 通过监督式修订样本，将目标截图与渲染截图之间的差异同纠正代码对齐。后续强化学习阶段利用视觉改进学习自修订，在训练中建立代码变化与其渲染结果之间的联系。
entries.evidence_note: Read both sources of refinement pairs and the start of the RL reward formulation. No training or ablation reproduction.

entries.label: Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement
entries.title: Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement for Frontend Code Generation
authors: Gerrit J. J. van den Burg
entries.english: Renders code from a natural-language request, obtains visual critique, translates that critique into code-level advice, and iteratively revises the implementation. Retains the best judged candidate and studies LoRA distillation; the visual signal is output feedback rather than a required reference screenshot.
entries.chinese: 渲染根据自然语言请求生成的代码，获取视觉评审，将其转化为代码层面的建议，再迭代修改实现。保留评审得分最高的候选并研究 LoRA 蒸馏；视觉信号来自输出反馈，而非必须提供的参考截图。
entries.evidence_note: Explicitly included under visual-feedback coding although the initial request is text. A model judge is not a functional test oracle.

entries.label: RubSE
entries.title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation
entries.english: Addresses visual repair coupling, where a local code edit can damage other rendered regions. Generates typed repair rubrics, selects one priority and records repair history to guide iterative UI refinement; rubric conditioning does not impose hard preservation guarantees.
entries.chinese: 针对视觉修复耦合问题：局部代码编辑可能破坏其他渲染区域。生成带类型的修复准则、选择一个优先目标并记录修复历史，以引导 UI 迭代改进；以准则为条件并不构成严格的区域保留保证。
entries.evidence_note: Read Evolve, Select and History operations. The paper explicitly distinguishes conditioning signals from hard constraints.

entries.label: Sketch-n-Sketch
entries.title: Semi-Automated SVG Programming via Direct Manipulation
entries.english: Lets users draw, relate and group shapes while transforming an exposed general-purpose program that renders SVG. This foundational direct-manipulation workflow creates reusable abstractions and edits source programs; it is not a block-based programming language or a neural screenshot model.
entries.chinese: 允许用户绘制、关联与分组形状，同时变换向用户开放、用于渲染 SVG 的通用程序。这一早期直接操控流程能创建可复用抽象并修改源程序；它不是积木式编程语言，也不是神经截图模型。
entries.evidence_note: Read the complete workflow overview, including the little language and grouping/abstraction example. The cited work is the 2016 paper, not the distinct 2019 sequel.

entries.label: Code Shaping
entries.title: Code Shaping: Iterative Code Editing with Free-form AI-Interpreted Sketching
entries.english: Uses free-form sketches over code and console or graphical output to communicate intended edits to an AI interpreter. Its design studies examine iterative reconciliation between sketches, model interpretations and source edits, rather than one-shot conversion of a UI mockup.
entries.chinese: 使用覆盖在代码、控制台或图形输出上的自由形式草图，向 AI 解释器表达预期修改。其设计研究考察草图、模型解释与源码编辑之间的迭代协调，而非一次性地将 UI 设计稿转换为代码。
entries.evidence_note: Read the interaction concept and the roles of the three study stages; participant findings were not independently reanalyzed.

entries.label: WebVIA
entries.title: WebVIA: A Web-based Vision-Language Agentic Framework for Interactive and Verifiable UI-to-Code Generation
entries.english: Explores rendered webpages with screenshot and DOM observations to collect UI states, generates interactive frontend code, and validates transitions. Its controlled synthetic environment and multi-state reconstruction distinguish it from single-screenshot static replication and general web-navigation benchmarks.
entries.chinese: 利用截图与 DOM 观察探索渲染网页、收集 UI 状态，生成交互式前端代码并验证状态转换。其受控合成环境与多状态重建，有别于单截图静态复现及通用网页导航基准。
entries.evidence_note: Read the multimodal state definition and the controlled environment. Does not claim screenshot-only exploration or arbitrary live-site cloning.

entries.label: Design2Code
entries.title: Design2Code: Benchmarking Multimodal Code Generation for Automated Front-End Engineering
entries.english: Evaluates screenshot-to-webpage reconstruction on curated real webpages using rendered visual similarity and element-level matching, complemented by human evaluation. Its metrics diagnose missing elements and layout errors; static visual fidelity does not establish interactive correctness.
entries.chinese: 在整理后的真实网页上评测截图到网页重建，采用渲染视觉相似度与元素级匹配，并辅以人工评估。其指标用于诊断元素缺失和布局错误；静态视觉保真度并不能证明交互正确。
entries.evidence_note: Read curation and metric definitions. v3 title and six-author list used; no cross-model rankings retained.

entries.label: Sketch2Code
entries.title: Sketch2Code: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Interactive Web Design Prototyping
entries.english: Tests conversion of rough sketches into webpage prototypes and supports multi-turn evaluation with a simulated user. Separates passive feedback following from proactive clarification questions, making it relevant to interactive design rather than only high-fidelity screenshot matching.
entries.chinese: 测试将粗略草图转换为网页原型，并支持与模拟用户进行多轮评测。区分被动遵循反馈与主动提出澄清问题，因此适用于交互式设计，而不仅是高保真截图匹配。
entries.evidence_note: The benchmark is the Ryan Li et al. paper, distinct from unrelated products and other papers using the same Sketch2Code name.

entries.label: Interaction2Code
entries.title: Interaction2Code: Benchmarking MLLM-based Interactive Webpage Code Generation from Interactive Prototyping
entries.english: Benchmarks interactive webpage generation from visual prototypes using automatic and human assessment. Studies interaction-specific failure modes and enhancement strategies such as element highlighting and combined visual–textual descriptions; static appearance alone is not its evaluation target.
entries.chinese: 通过自动与人工评估，测试根据视觉原型生成交互式网页。研究交互特有的失效模式，以及元素高亮、视觉与文本描述结合等增强策略；其评测目标不限于静态外观。
entries.evidence_note: Primary v3 abstract/history/metadata checked. The reviewed title and nine-author list differ from the earlier v1 record; no detailed protocol or experimental reproduction is implied.

entries.label: DesignBench
entries.title: DesignBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MLLM-based Front-end Code Generation
entries.english: Evaluates generation, instruction-driven editing and visual-issue repair across React, Vue, Angular and vanilla HTML/CSS. Task inputs differ: editing uses an existing image, code and instruction, whereas repair uses problematic code and its rendered image.
entries.chinese: 在 React、Vue、Angular 和原生 HTML/CSS 上评测生成、指令驱动编辑及视觉问题修复。各任务输入不同：编辑使用已有图像、代码与指令，修复则使用有问题的代码及其渲染图像。
entries.evidence_note: Read task definitions and collection provenance; not all tasks require a target screenshot. Counts from task instances and unique pages should not be conflated.

entries.label: 1D-Bench
entries.title: 1D-Bench: A Benchmark for Iterative UI Code Generation with Visual Feedback in Real-World
entries.english: Tests executable React projects from a reference rendering plus a potentially defective design intermediate representation under a fixed toolchain. Multi-round feedback includes renders, difference heatmaps or failure logs; evaluation separates rendering success from visual similarity.
entries.chinese: 在固定工具链下，测试根据参考渲染图与可能含缺陷的设计中间表示生成可执行 React 项目。多轮反馈包含渲染图、差异热图或失败日志；评测区分渲染成功率与视觉相似度。
entries.evidence_note: Read v3 task and score definitions. The reference rendering, not literal adherence to noisy IR, is the visual target.

entries.label: MT-Web2Code
entries.title: MT-Web2Code: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Multi-Turn Regional Reconstruction and Localized Modification
entries.english: Constructs multi-turn regional reconstruction and localized modification tasks by corrupting golden webpages and reversing those trajectories. Evaluates target repair together with preservation of unaffected content, exposing cumulative editing errors; it is distinct from the earlier Web2Code dataset.
entries.chinese: 通过破坏标准网页并逆转这些轨迹，构建多轮区域重建与局部修改任务。同时评测目标修复和未受影响内容的保留，以揭示累积编辑错误；它与较早的 Web2Code 数据集不同。
entries.evidence_note: Task formulation and preprocessing inspected; dual-axis evaluation identity checked against the abstract. Release was promised in the abstract, not independently confirmed.

entries.label: TaoD2C-Bench
entries.title: TaoD2C-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Industrial UI Code Generation Beyond Visual Fidelity
entries.english: Tests industrial UI generation from design images, layer metadata and target-library documentation. Separates end-to-end generation, requirement inference and requirement realization, evaluating implementation constraints separately from visual fidelity.
entries.chinese: 测试根据设计图像、图层元数据与目标组件库文档生成工业级 UI。区分端到端生成、需求推断与需求实现，并将实现约束评测与视觉保真度评测分开。
entries.evidence_note: Submission record confirms 2026-10-07, within the cutoff despite the large identifier. Read tasks and metrics; no dataset or evaluator execution.

entries.label: IR4RL
entries.title: Reinforcement Learning from Intermediate Renders for Image-to-Code Generation
entries.english: Turns changes between intermediate rendered code prefixes into localized reinforcement-learning rewards and combines them with a final-output signal. Evaluated on image-to-SVG and image-to-TikZ; the rendering-supervision idea is relevant, but the paper does not establish frontend UI results.
entries.chinese: 将代码前缀的中间渲染结果之间的变化转化为局部强化学习奖励，并与最终输出信号结合。评测面向图像到 SVG 和图像到 TikZ；其渲染监督思想具有相关性，但论文并未证明其前端 UI 效果。
entries.evidence_note: Read prefix closure, reward deltas, token propagation and combined outcome/process objective. Included as a clearly bounded adjacent task.
